name: Netflow Operations Health v2
description: Operational health with enhanced KPI prominence - direction coverage, DNS resolution, enrichment quality, and data quality trends.

0.content:
# Netflow Operations Health v2
**Is something wrong?** Data quality, direction coverage, DNS resolution, and enrichment status with anomaly detection.

1.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize total = count(), unknown = countIf(coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "unknown")
| fieldsAdd pct = round(100.0 * unknown / total, decimals: 1)
1.title: Unknown Direction %

2.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize total = count(), unresolved = countIf(coalesce(`netflow.destination.hostname`, "") == "")
| fieldsAdd pct = round(100.0 * unresolved / total, decimals: 1)
2.title: DNS Resolution Issues %

3.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize total = count(), unenriched = countIf((coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "") == "" or coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "") == "private") and coalesce(`netflow.destination.asn`, "") == "")
| fieldsAdd pct = round(100.0 * unenriched / total, decimals: 1)
3.title: Unenriched IPs %

4.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize total = count(), with_direction = countIf(isNotNull(`netflow.flow.direction`)), with_hostname = countIf(isNotNull(`netflow.destination.hostname`)), with_enrichment = countIf(isNotNull(`netflow.destination.provider`) and `netflow.destination.provider` != "private")
| fieldsAdd quality_score = round((with_direction * 0.4 + with_hostname * 0.3 + with_enrichment * 0.3) / total * 100.0, decimals: 1)
4.title: Data Quality Score

5.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| makeTimeseries total_flows = count(), unknown_direction = countIf(coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "unknown"), unresolved_dns = countIf(coalesce(`netflow.destination.hostname`, "") == ""), unenriched_ips = countIf((coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "") == "" or coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "") == "private") and coalesce(`netflow.destination.asn`, "") == ""), interval: 5m
5.title: Data Quality Trend (Flow Count + Quality Issues)

6.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| filter coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "unknown"
| summarize flow_count = count(), bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), by: {src_ip = coalesce(`netflow.source.ip`, "unknown")}
| fieldsAdd gb = round(bytes / 1073741824.0, decimals: 3)
| sort flow_count desc
| limit 20
6.title: Unknown Direction Sources (Top 20)

7.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| filter coalesce(`netflow.destination.hostname`, "") == ""
| summarize flow_count = count(), bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), by: {dst_ip = coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, "unknown")}
| fieldsAdd gb = round(bytes / 1073741824.0, decimals: 3)
| sort flow_count desc
| limit 20
7.title: Unresolved DNS Destinations (Top 20)

8.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| filter (coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "") == "" or coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "") == "private") and coalesce(`netflow.destination.asn`, "") == ""
| summarize flow_count = count(), bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), by: {dst_ip = coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, "unknown"), dst_hostname = coalesce(`netflow.destination.hostname`, "unresolved")}
| fieldsAdd gb = round(bytes / 1073741824.0, decimals: 3)
| sort flow_count desc
| limit 20
8.title: Unenriched IPs (Top 20 - No Provider/ASN)

9.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| filter coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "unknown"
| summarize bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), flow_count = count(), by: {src_ip = coalesce(`netflow.source.ip`, "unknown"), dst_ip = coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, "unknown"), protocol = coalesce(`netflow.network.transport`, "unknown")}
| fieldsAdd gb = round(bytes / 1073741824.0, decimals: 3)
| filter gb > 0.01
| sort gb desc
| limit 20
9.title: Suspicious Outbound (Unknown Direction + High Volume)

10.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize 
  total_flows = count(),
  total_bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))),
  unknown_direction_flows = countIf(coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown") == "unknown"),
  unresolved_dns_flows = countIf(coalesce(`netflow.destination.hostname`, "") == ""),
  unenriched_flows = countIf((coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "") == "" or coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "") == "private") and coalesce(`netflow.destination.asn`, "") == ""),
  by: {}
| fieldsAdd 
  pct_unknown_dir = round(100.0 * unknown_direction_flows / total_flows, decimals: 1),
  pct_unresolved_dns = round(100.0 * unresolved_dns_flows / total_flows, decimals: 1),
  pct_unenriched = round(100.0 * unenriched_flows / total_flows, decimals: 1),
  total_gb = round(total_bytes / 1073741824.0, decimals: 2)
10.title: All Quality Issues Summary
